title: Three named utility, water, and servicing records deepen the local dossiers
summary: FTFN added SRP's 2025 system-plan progress report, Phoenix Water Services' April 2026 council update, and Toronto's June 2026 decision report for application 24 254930. The resulting signals remain In Review and preserve the distinction between system planning, project-stage review, service commitments, permits, construction, and completed outcomes.
evidence_note: All three selections use official provider or municipal records checked on July 22, 2026. None is treated as proof of site-level service, final approval, building permits, starts, completions, or occupancy.
